notes: Layer files with a pick-list, paste onto a sheet or range, and tabs keep their zoom and position.

features: Export layers to a file and import them into another takeoff: Export > Layers to file / Layers from file. A picker lets you tick exactly which layers go in the file.

Paste layers onto a sheet you choose - the 'onto sheet' box beside Paste takes 5, or a range like 4-8, or 2,4-6. Several sheets repeat the marks on each. Blank keeps the sheet numbers the marks came from.
fixes: Each takeoff tab now keeps its own zoom, pan and scroll position instead of resetting when you switch.
